tool_args.rationale: The positive short-window pilot is consistent with endogenous adaptation, but the slow component is unidentifiable from these short horizons and is critical at H=23. The slow_horizon_discriminating_probe is the targeted measurement needed before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations have short horizons (0.16–0.48), so they cannot identify the slow component or establish behavior near the forecast horizon H=23.
More short-window measurements would not resolve the long-horizon reversal ambiguity.
This measurement is not relevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms.
